code_examples.section: ltm rule event WS SERVER FRAME
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

WS_SERVER_FRAME
       This event is raised when a new Websocket frame is encountered on server side.

DESCRIPTION
       This event is raised to indicate the start of a Websocket frame received from the server.

Examples
	when WS_SERVER_FRAME {
	    WS::frame drop
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.1.0
	   --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
